 Nova M Bajamonti Sun, November 8, 2026 at 3:02 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. PERTH, AUSTRALIA - DECEMBER 28: Iga Swiatek of Team Poland poses following a surfing lesson at Scarborough Beach ahead of the 2024 United Cup on December 28, 2023 in Perth, Australia. (Photo by Paul Kane/Getty Images) (Getty Images) Tennis star Iga Świątek  flaunted her impressive abs while donning a tiny black and white striped bikini on social media.
 The athlete visited the Maldives and shared a plethora of pictures during her rest and recharge period.
 Her online carousels featured her lounging beachside, snorkeling, fine dining, and making memories with her friends and family during her "vacation mode."
 Iga shared a carousel of her recent vacation (@ Instagram)
 She provided more insight into her recent adventures, while captioning her post: "I know, I know… you guys missed me. Don't worry, I'm about to make up for it with a little vacation update."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Iga continued: "[I] read books on the beach with these amazing views. Met some of the local wildlife and underwater too. [I] ate lots of delicious food. Watched some breathtaking sunsets with the best people."
 The star joked: "I did take a little break from tennis…well sort of," as she was spotted with her tennis racket while on her vacation. Iga's downtime came shortly after the star ended her on season earlier than usual.
 The athlete admitted that she suffered from a left thigh injury, which forced her to opt out of competing in the Ningbo Open. Her decision meant that she no longer had a chance of a WTA Finals qualification.
 The athlete enjoyed downtime in the Maldives (@ Instagram)
 She admitted on social media on October 20: "The past few months, or actually the past couple of years, have been incredibly intense and I feel I need to rest and recover my body fully. So that's exactly what I will do, a bit longer this time. I've decided to end my season here, which means I won't be playing any more tournaments this year.

 The star recently suffered from an injury (@ Instagram)
 She added: "I'm feeling grateful for everything this year has taught me and very much loving what I do. As always, I'll come back with passion and motivation to keep improving. Thank you for being with me and see you soon."
 Advertisement Advertisement Fans loved Iga's wholesome post and flocked to the comments to support her. One person wrote: "My little two-year-old was asking me this afternoon 'Mom, where's Iga?' I told her you are resting. Great to know you're resting in Maldives! Great place!"
 She took a break from competing recently (@ Instagram)
 A second follower added: "I do miss you and was thinking about when you gonna post off-season, and now…" with a heart emoji.
 A third fan joked: "Well deserved reset. I refuse to follow any WTA updates when you are not around. Enjoy!"
 One person continued: "Aaaaa Iga, you have no idea how much we miss you! Seeing you enjoy your vacation happily with your besties makes us so relieved and joyful. We love you more than anything. All we wish for is your health and happiness."
